content: I have been asked to advertise the Workshop Schlumberger organised on June 15th at IHES (near Paris) by Thierry Coquand and focusing on Dependent Type Theory and Formalization of Mathematics. Unfortunately the event will not be streamed online, but all talks will be recorded and made available on the IHES website.

Dear Lean users,

I attach below the slides of my talk How to Do Maths without Dependent Types. In addition to Grothendieck's schemes, I show in the slides how one can formalise sheaves of modules in Isabelle and how one can handle families of schemes (as requested by @Kevin Buzzard and @Jeremy Avigad , respectively).
talk_schemes.pdf

The recorded talk is also available on the IHES' youtube channel here, but like all the other talks it's in French with the slides in English.
